caption: The drawing depicts a spherical, orange-brown object placed on a flat, brown wooden surface. The object has green markings on its surface, which form the numbers "1843" in the upper section and the letters "OK" in the lower section, each separated by a horizontal green wavy line. The object is set within a circular gray background bordered with a white ring. The circle is inscribed with the text “PLATE - 1843” at the top, outside the main orange-brown object. The surrounding area outside the circle is a plain beige color.
title: Pie Plate
